script:
# Inspect the structure of both input files
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
xlsx_path <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
# CSV: read header rows
csv_lines <- readLines(csv_path, n = 5)
cat("=== CSV first lines ===\n")
for (line in csv_lines) cat(line, "\n")

# Read CSV with base R, skipping the first metadata row
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
# Read first 2 lines to understand
hdr1 <- readLines(csv_path, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
hdr2 <- readLines(csv_path, n = 2, warn = FALSE)[2]
cat("Row 1 (groups):", hdr1, "\n")
cat("Row 2 (samples):", hdr2, "\n\n")
# Read from line 2 with col1 as gene name

# ============================================================
# Synthetic volcano plot (Diagonal Volcano Plot) in R
# ============================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
# ---- Load differential analysis result ----
de <- readxl::read_xlsx(xlsx_path, sheet = "Sheet 1")
# Clean and prepare
df <- de %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC   = as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
    pvalue   = as.numeric(pvalue),
    negLog10P = -log10(pmax(pvalue, 1e-300))   # avoid Inf
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC), !is.na(pvalue))
cat("Rows after cleaning:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("LFC range:", range(df$log2FC), "\n")
cat("negLog10P range:", range(df$negLog10P), "\n")
# ---- Cutoffs ----
lfc_cut <- 1            # |log2FC| > 1
p_cut   <- 0.05         # pvalue < 0.05
negLog10P_cut <- -log10(p_cut)   # ≈ 1.301
# ---- Classify significance (diagonal criterion) ----
# A gene is "diagonally significant" if BOTH:
#   |log2FC| > lfc_cut
#   -log10(p) > negLog10P_cut + (|log2FC| - lfc_cut) * slope
# That is, beyond the V-shape whose vertex sits at (±lfc_cut, negLog10P_cut)
slope <- 1   # 45° diagonal cutoff
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diag_threshold = negLog10P_cut + (abs(log2FC) - lfc_cut) * slope,
    Significance = case_when(
      log2FC >  lfc_cut & negLog10P > diag_threshold ~ "Up",
      log2FC < -lfc_cut & negLog10P > diag_threshold ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )
cat("\nSignificance counts:\n")
print(table(df$Significance))
# Save processed df for downstream use
saveRDS(df, "diag_volcano_df.rds")

# ============================================================
# Diagonal Volcano Plot
# ============================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
# Reload prepared data
df <- readRDS("data/diag_volcano_df.rds")
lfc_cut <- 1
p_cut   <- 0.05
negLog10P_cut <- -log10(p_cut)
slope <- 1
# ---- Pick top genes to label (most extreme by |log2FC|*negLog10P) ----
top_n <- 25
top_genes <- df %>%
  filter(Significance != "NS") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC) * negLog10P)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n)
cat("Top labeled genes:\n")
print(top_genes %>% select(id, log2FC, negLog10P, Significance) %>% head(10))
# ---- Build diagonal cutoff line segments for drawing ----
# V-shape: vertex at (±lfc_cut, negLog10P_cut), arms extend outward with slope ±1
x_max <- max(abs(df$log2FC)) * 1.02
y_at_xmax <- negLog10P_cut + (x_max - lfc_cut) * slope
diag_line <- data.frame(
  x = c(-x_max, -lfc_cut, lfc_cut, x_max),
  y = c(y_at_xmax, negLog10P_cut, negLog10P_cut, y_at_xmax),
  group = c(1, 1, 2, 2)
)
# ---- Colors ----
col_up   <- "#D7263D"   # red
col_down <- "#1B998B"   # teal
col_ns   <- "#9AA0A6"   # grey
col_line <- "#2B2D42"   # dark
# ---- Plot ----
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P, colour = Significance, fill = Significance)) +
  # diagonal cutoff V
  geom_line(data = diag_line, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = col_line, linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
  # points
  geom_point(data = filter(df, Significance == "NS"),
             aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P),
             size = 1.1, alpha = 0.45, colour = col_ns) +
  geom_point(data = filter(df, Significance == "Down"),
             aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P),
             size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85, colour = col_down) +
  geom_point(data = filter(df, Significance == "Up"),
             aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P),
             size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85, colour = col_up) +
  # highlight & label top genes
  geom_point(data = top_genes, aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P),
             size = 2.0, shape = 21, colour = "black",
             fill = "gold", stroke = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                  aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P, label = id),
                  size = 3.0, max.overlaps = 60,
                  box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.2,
                  segment.color = "grey30", segment.size = 0.25,
                  min.segment.length = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # guides & theme
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up" = col_up, "Down" = col_down, "NS" = col_ns),
                      breaks = c("Up", "Down", "NS")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = col_up, "Down" = col_down, "NS" = col_ns)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "Significance", order = 1,
                               override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),
         fill = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = negLog10P_cut, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = sprintf("|log2FC| > %g  &  -log10(p) > %.2f + (|log2FC| - %g)·slope=%g",
                       lfc_cut, negLog10P_cut, lfc_cut, slope),
    x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)"),
    caption = sprintf("Total genes: %d   |   Up: %d   Down: %d   NS: %d",
                      nrow(df),
                      sum(df$Significance == "Up"),
                      sum(df$Significance == "Down"),
                      sum(df$Significance == "NS"))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
# ---- Save ----
out_png <- "Synthetic volcano plot.png"
ggsave(out_png, p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved:", out_png, "\n")
cat("File exists:", file.exists(out_png), " size:", file.info(out_png)$size, "bytes\n")

# Check working directory and where rds was actually saved
cat("CWD:", getwd(), "\n")
cat("data/ contents:\n")
print(list.files("data", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
# Find the rds
rds_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.rds$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
cat("\nAll rds files:\n")
print(rds_files)
# Also check root level
cat("\nRoot contents:\n")
print(list.files(".", recursive = FALSE))

# ============================================================
# Diagonal Volcano Plot — self-contained (no stale state)
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(dplyr)
})
# ---- Load differential analysis result ----
xlsx_path <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
de <- readxl::read_xlsx(xlsx_path, sheet = "Sheet 1")
df <- de %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC    = as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
    pvalue    = as.numeric(pvalue),
    negLog10P = -log10(pmax(pvalue, 1e-300))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC), !is.na(pvalue))
cat("Rows after cleaning:", nrow(df), "\n")
# ---- Cutoffs & diagonal classification ----
lfc_cut       <- 1
p_cut         <- 0.05
negLog10P_cut <- -log10(p_cut)
slope         <- 1
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diag_threshold = negLog10P_cut + (abs(log2FC) - lfc_cut) * slope,
    Significance = case_when(
      log2FC >  lfc_cut & negLog10P > diag_threshold ~ "Up",
      log2FC < -lfc_cut & negLog10P > diag_threshold ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )
cat("Counts: "); print(table(df$Significance))
# ---- Pick top genes to label ----
top_genes <- df %>%
  filter(Significance != "NS") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC) * negLog10P)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 25)
# ---- Diagonal V-cutoff line ----
x_max   <- max(abs(df$log2FC)) * 1.02
y_at_x  <- negLog10P_cut + (x_max - lfc_cut) * slope
diag_line <- data.frame(
  x = c(-x_max, -lfc_cut, lfc_cut, x_max),
  y = c(y_at_x,  negLog10P_cut, negLog10P_cut, y_at_x),
  group = c(1, 1, 2, 2)
)
# ---- Theme colors ----
col_up   <- "#D7263D"
col_down <- "#1B998B"
col_ns   <- "#9AA0A6"
col_line <- "#2B2D42"
# ---- Build plot ----
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10P)) +
  geom_line(data = diag_line, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = col_line,
            linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(Significance == "NS"),
             colour = col_ns, size = 1.1, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(Significance == "Down"),
             colour = col_down, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = df %>% filter(Significance == "Up"),
             colour = col_up,   size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = top_genes,
             shape = 21, fill = "gold", colour = "black",
             stroke = 0.4, size = 2.0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                  aes(label = id),
                  size = 3.0, max.overlaps = 60,
                  box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.2,
                  segment.color = "grey30", segment.size = 0.25,
                  min.segment.length = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = negLog10P_cut,
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Manual legend
  annotate("point", x = Inf, y = Inf, colour = col_up,   size = 3, shape = 16) +
  annotate("text",  x = Inf, y = Inf, label = "Up",
           hjust = -0.6, vjust = 0.5, colour = col_up,   fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("point", x = Inf, y = Inf, colour = col_down, size = 3, shape = 16) +
  annotate("text",  x = Inf, y = Inf, label = "Down",
           hjust = -0.6, vjust = 1.8, colour = col_down, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("point", x = Inf, y = Inf, colour = col_ns,   size = 3, shape = 16) +
  annotate("text",  x = Inf, y = Inf, label = "NS",
           hjust = -0.6, vjust = 3.1, colour = col_ns,   fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title    = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = sprintf("Cutoffs: |log2FC| > %g  &  -log10(p) > %.2f + (|log2FC| - %g) · slope=%g",
                       lfc_cut, negLog10P_cut, lfc_cut, slope),
    x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)"),
    caption  = sprintf("Total genes: %d   |   Up: %d   Down: %d   NS: %d",
                       nrow(df),
                       sum(df$Significance == "Up"),
                       sum(df$Significance == "Down"),
                       sum(df$Significance == "NS"))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
out_png <- "Synthetic volcano plot.png"
ggsave(out_png, p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved:", out_png, "\n")
cat("Size:", file.info(out_png)$size, "bytes\n")
